candidates.metaphor: Many direction arrows press inward on a single small circle from every edge; the circle dims and shrinks under the accumulated pressure.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Each arrow is one external opinion; because they all point at the same center, the viewer reads external pressure converging on one person — the circle's reduced scale and dimmed accent show energy spent absorbing it.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Arrows aimed at a lone dot is instantly readable as 'everyone judging me,' and the dot visibly shrinking performs the exhaustion rather than naming it.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline uppercase 96px left, emphasis words 'bikin capek' in gold; label under figure.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Arrows stagger-slide inward (stagger), circle subtleScale down + highlight, glow stays subordinate.
candidates.whyItWorks: Enacts pressure physically; single dominant gold accent carries the fatigue phrase.

candidates.metaphor: A circular arrow track keeps spinning while a small pill labeled POSTED appears, gets struck out, and reappears — an infinite unfinishable cycle.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The loop never returns to a resting state: each revolution produces and deletes the same item, so repetition without resolution visibly equals wasted energy.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A spinning cycle with a repeating create-delete beat reads as 'over and over, never done' even with sound off.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal headline word-by-word, 'bikin capek' gold-accented.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Circle draw rotation, card controlledReveal then fade exit, stagger text.
candidates.whyItWorks: Different metaphor family (temporal loop vs spatial pressure) and performs the 'capek' as futility.

candidates.metaphor: One outlined figure stands fixed while a detached shadow beside it repeatedly stretches, flattens and reshapes to match shifting silhouette templates.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The figure stays constant but the shadow is continually re-cut to fit others' expected shapes; the mismatch and re-cutting motion shows energy spent managing perception instead of existing.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A shadow that won't stay its own shape reads as pretending to be what people want; the figure's dimming shows the cost.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left-aligned headline block, muted subline, gold on 'bikin capek'.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Shadow line slide/controlledReveal reshapes, figure fade opacity drop, subtleScale.
candidates.whyItWorks: Bridges the later 'pencitraan/sombong' idea at the open and stays quiet and uneasy.

candidates.metaphor: A horizontal meter labeled YOU sits under a row of tiny opinion sliders, each moving randomly and pulling the meter's value steadily down.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Multiple independent external inputs drain one finite stored value — the falling counter performs 'energy spent on others' as a measurable loss.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A bar emptying while many knobs twitch is universal for 'drained by everything else.'
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-left, ProgressBar label 'Niat', counter change as emphasis.
candidates.motionOpportunity: counterChange on value, stagger grid cells, highlight.
candidates.whyItWorks: Quantifies fatigue, distinct object set from arrow/loop candidates.

candidates.concept: CROWD OF LABELS, ONE SMALL SELF
candidates.metaphor: A ring of small pill badges (nice, quiet, lucky, fake) orbits a tiny center mark that flickers between colors trying to match each one.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The center has no stable state because each orbiting label demands a different identity; the flicker-and-mismatch cycle shows exhaustion from constant adjustment.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Floating judgment words surrounding a small unsure dot reads immediately as 'everyone's opinions pressing in.'
candidates.typographyStrategy: Centered uppercase headline, max 2 gold words.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Badges stagger orbit-in, circle highlight/flicker, fade.
candidates.whyItWorks: Uses the script's actual judgment vocabulary later, planting it early; low clutter.

candidates.concept: WRITE, SEND, STRIKE — THE POST LOOP
candidates.metaphor: A single post card cycles through POST → HAPUS, its draft text repeatedly typed then struck out, never landing.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The card stays in place while its state flips: text draws in, a red strike cuts it, the card dims and resets — an endless loop that performs 'posting then deleting' instead of naming it.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Seeing content appear and get crossed out over and over reads instantly as 'I can never leave it up' — the repetition itself is the anxiety.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'HAPUS LAGI' in uppercase with 'hapus lagi' as the red accent phrase; short caption below.
candidates.motionOpportunity: draw for typed text, highlight for the strike, fade for the reset — one loop system, 2-3 animated elements.
candidates.whyItWorks: Literalizes the beat's emphasis phrase as a repeating physical event; the loop has no exit, which is the fear.

candidates.metaphor: A circle outline representing the true self gets shoved by outside pressure into a distorted shape, then snaps back.
candidates.semanticMechanism: External judgment arrows press from all sides; the outline deforms under them and quietly reforms when released — authenticity visibly bent but never allowed to settle.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A shape being forced to change by pushing forces reads as 'changing yourself for others' without any text needed.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left of center, max two accent words: 'DIPAKSA BEDA' with 'dipaksa' in gold.
candidates.motionOpportunity: positionShift and subtleScale on arrows, controlledReveal on the deformation, fade exit.
candidates.whyItWorks: Second metaphor family (deformation vs repetition) and directly matches the 'cermin dipaksa berubah bentuk' hint.

candidates.concept: FILTER GATE BETWEEN SELF AND WORLD
candidates.metaphor: A word leaves the person's side and must pass a narrow judgment gate; anything with personality gets clipped at the opening.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Unfiltered words travel toward the gate; only bland, edited versions emerge on the other side while the rejected ones fade — the gate physically censors expression.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Watching words get cut down to safe versions at a barrier is an immediate read of self-censorship.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Two-word label on each side of the gate; headline above, 'TAKUT DIJUDGE' with one red accent word.
candidates.motionOpportunity: slide for words crossing, highlight for the clipping moment, fade for rejected words.
candidates.whyItWorks: A third distinct family (spatial filtering) that shows the cause (fear at the gate) rather than only the loop.

candidates.metaphor: A checklist where each self-edit item is ticked then immediately unchecked, the marks cycling forever while the list never empties.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Checkmarks draw in, hold, and un-draw in sequence — visible progress that retracts to zero, performing effort that produces nothing.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Ticking and un-ticking is universally read as 'done, not done' — endless redoing with no result.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 'NGEDIT TERUS' left; checklist labels carry the beat's three actions (ngomong, berpakaian, posting).
candidates.motionOpportunity: stagger across checkboxes, highlight on check, fade on uncheck; one motion system only.
candidates.whyItWorks: Uses a familiar UI object for instant decoding and differs from cards and shapes by being a list-based metaphor.

candidates.concept: SPOT THAT RETURNS AFTER EVERY WIPE
candidates.metaphor: Bidang gelap bersih: satu bintik merah dihapus, lalu muncul lagi sendiri di posisi lain — permukaan tetap bersih kecuali bintik yang tak pernah habis.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Aksi hapus lalu tumbuh ulang membuktikan secanggih apa pun upaya membersihkan, bintik selalu terbentuk kembali: kehilangan suka adalah struktural, bukan kesalahan bidang.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Penonton melihat bintik dihapus dan muncul lagi tanpa sebab baru — pesan 'nggak bisa dihindari' terbaca dari kelingking saja, teks hanya memperkuat.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline uppercase 2 baris 'PASTI ADA AJA / YANG NGGAK SUKA', aksen merah pada 'nggak suka', label kecil di bawah bidang.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Bintik dissolve lalu scale-muncul ulang (stagger), headline WordReveal kiri-ke-kanan, bidang diam sebagai jangkar.
candidates.whyItWorks: Enactment langsung: kejadian di layar melakukan arti 'tak terhindarkan', bukan sekadar ikon bintik.

candidates.concept: ARROWS FROM EVERY DIRECTION AT ONCE
candidates.metaphor: Sebuah lingkaran kecil di tengah menerima panah-panah kecil dari segala arah tepi frame, datang bergiliran tak peduli lingkaran itu diam atau bergerak.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Arah panah yang menutupi 360° membuat arah aman secara fisik tidak ada; lingkaran bisa berpindah tetapi selalu masuk lintasan panah baru.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Kepala penonton otomatis mencari 'arah kosong' dan tidak menemukannya — hasil pencarian visual itu sendiri adalah kesimpulan.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline kiri besar 'MAU LU NGAPAIN JUGA', frase penekanan 'PASTI ADA AJA YANG NGGAK SUKA' muncul sebagai baris kedua dengan aksen merah.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Panah entrance slide bertahap dari tepi (stagger), lingkaran subtleScale saat panah tiba, lalu semua panah fade menjelang akhir.
candidates.whyItWorks: Metafora arah tidak pernah bisa diblokir 100% cocok dengan kalimat 'mau lu ngapain juga'.

candidates.concept: EVERY BRANCH ENDS THE SAME WAY
candidates.metaphor: Satu batang 'MAU LU NGAPAIN' bercabang ke banyak pilihan; setiap cabang berujung pada node merah berlabel 'nggak suka'.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Pembagian struktural dari satu truk ke semua cabang yang berakhir identik menunjukkan hasil akhir tidak bergantung pada pilihan — seluruh ruang opsi bermuara sama.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Mata mengikuti cabang demi cabang mencari jalur hijau, seluruhnya merah; pola berulang itu menjelaskan 'pasti ada aja' tanpa perlu narasi.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 2 baris di atas, aksen gold pada 'PASTI ADA AJA'; caption kecil menutup di bawah diagram.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Diagram draw/stagger cabang satu per satu, node merah highlight saat terbentuk, headline reveal lebih dulu.
candidates.whyItWorks: Mengubah kata 'mau ngapain' menjadi pohon keputusan nyata, jadi penonton melihat mustahilnya bukan mendengarnya.

candidates.concept: APPROVAL BAR THAT NEVER REACHES FULL
candidates.metaphor: Dua bar pendekatan: upaya terisi penuh tapi bar 'disukai semua orang' mentok di 92% dan bergetar tanpa pernah menyentuh 100%.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Angka yang terus mencoba naik namun ditahan pada plafon memperlihatkan batas maksimum yang tidak bisa ditembus — targetnya yang mustahil, bukan upayanya.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Semua orang paham bar yang macet; frustasi yang dirasakan saat bar tidak penuh adalah emosi yang sama dengan beat ini.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal headline di sisi kiri, bar dan angka di sisi kanan, aksen merah pada persentase yang mentok.
candidates.motionOpportunity: counterChange pada nilai bar yang naik lalu memantul turun sedikit, highlight pada plafon, fade keluar.
candidates.whyItWorks: Menyajikan 'secara struktural mustahil' sebagai data visual yang tak terbantahkan sekaligus menenangkan: bukan upaya lu yang kurang.

candidates.metaphor: Bidikan tepat sasaran, tetapi bidangan bergeser sebelum panah sampai; setiap tembakan akurat berakhir meleset karena sasaran tak pernah diam.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Akurasi penonton terbukti benar namun hasil tetap gagal — memisahkan kualitas tindakan dari penilaian luar, menyalahkan sistem bukan pelaku.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Rasa adil langsung terpicu: 'tembakannya bagus, targetnya yang lari' — persis pesan bahwa penilaian negatif bukan salah kita.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline kiri 3 baris maksimal, aksen gold pada 'PASTI ADA AJA', label kecil 'SEBERAPA PUN TEPATNYA' di bawah target.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Panah draw lalu target positionShift ke sisi lain, ulang dua kali, headline stagger mengikuti tiap tembakan.
candidates.whyItWorks: Memberi kontras tindakan vs penilaian yang menjadi inti pergeseran paradigma, dengan objek simbolik kuat.

candidates.metaphor: Dua kolom — tindakan di kiri, vonis di kanan. Garis penghubung yang seharusnya lurus justru berpotongan diagonal di tengah frame.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Setiap anak panah aksi→vonis menyeberang ke lajur berlawanan; titik potong dua garis menampilkan bahwa narasi selalu dibalik, bukan mengalir sebab-akt.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Kolom kiri dan kanan tidak pernah terhubung garis lurus — semua jalur menyilang, jadi penonton membaca 'koneksi yang kusut' tanpa perlu teks penjelas.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline uppercase 96px kiri atas dengan satu kata gold 'DIBALIK'; label kolom 34px tracking lebar.
candidates.motionOpportunity: stagger label kolom masuk, draw dua panah bersilangan, highlight singkat di titik tabrakan.
candidates.whyItWorks: Memaksa mata menelusuri jalur yang salah arah — ironi tampil sebagai geometri, bukan sebagai kalimat.

candidates.metaphor: Jarum penilaian tunggal di poros: setiap input baru (baik, diem, sukses, gagal) membalikkannya 180 derajat ke sisi berlawanan.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Objek dan porosnya identik, hanya arah jarum yang berubah total — perubahan radikal berasal dari alat ukur, bukan dari yang diukur.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Satu jarum yang terus dibalik-balik menunjukkan mesin penilaian yang memang dirancang untuk menentang; penonton melihat konsistensi kebalikannya.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline tengah 2 baris maks, kata 'VONIS' gold; caption 30px sebagai label jarum.
candidates.motionOpportunity: positionShift jarum 180° per baris (4x), subtleScale pada lingkaran poros, fade caption.
candidates.whyItWorks: Sederhana, mudah dibaca dalam 1.8 detik, dan enak ditonton berulang karena ritme kibasnya jelas.

candidates.metaphor: Panah melesat tepat ke sasaran, lalu sasaran bergeser ke posisi baru — setiap kali lu memenuhi kriteria, gawangnya dipindah.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Panah selalu benar (akurasi konstan), sasaran yang selalu berpindah — kesalahan terletak pada sasaran yang tidak pernah bisa ditekan.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Anak panah tertancap di titik kosong setelah sasaran menjauh; penonton langsung mengenali 'moving goalpost' tanpa narasi.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline kiri 96px 2 baris, satu kata gold 'SASARAN'; label target kecil center di bawah objek.
candidates.motionOpportunity: slide panah masuk, controlledReveal perpindahan target, highlight titik tancap yang kosong.
candidates.whyItWorks: Metafora fisik yang universal: usaha terukur vs kriteria yang melar, terbaca dari gerakan saja.

candidates.metaphor: Kalimat tindakan berdiri di atas; pantulannya di bawah membalik 180° dan berubah menjadi vonis yang berlawanan.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Dua lapis teks dengan rotasi identik tapi isi berlawanan — pantulan selalu menghasilkan makna terbalik, menyalahkan cermin bukan objek.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Teks terbalik di bawah garis horison terbaca sebagai pantulan yang 'merusak' makna aslinya; penonton melihat dua versi dari satu hal yang sama.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal baris atas (aksi) + WordReveal pantulan rotasi 180° di bawah, satu kata gold di baris atas saja.
candidates.motionOpportunity: stagger kata baris atas, maskedTransition pantulan muncul, subtleScale garis horison.
candidates.whyItWorks: Mendahului teks: bentuk pantulan terbalik sudah mengkhianati makna sebelum kata dibaca penuh.

candidates.concept: SAME CELL, CHECK FLIPS TO CROSS
candidates.metaphor: Grid empat baris; tiap baris satu sel berisi centang yang langsung berubah jadi silang pada baris berikutnya — penanda selalu berbalik.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Sel yang identik menerima tanda berlawanan berulang kali; perubahan tanda tanpa perubahan sel membuktikan penilaiannya sendiri yang tidak konsisten.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Empat sel sama, tanda saling bertukar positif/negatif; penonton melihat pola bolak-balik yang mustahil dijelaskan oleh isinya.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline 96px atas dengan kata gold 'APA PUN', label baris 26px di samping grid.
candidates.motionOpportunity: stagger baris grid masuk, highlight pergantian tanda per baris, fade akhir.
candidates.whyItWorks: Ritme repetisi 4x cocok untuk durasi 1.8s dan menegaskan bahwa pola, bukan kejadian tunggal, yang jadi masalah.

candidates.metaphor: Threads from a fist fan out to other people's thought-nodes; the fist opens and the threads slide free beyond reach, while one short line stays anchored to the self.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Control is shown physically as a held thread; release makes the threads visibly exit the hand's reach while a single owned line remains fixed — control exists only where the hand still holds.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: You see strands leaving an open palm and drifting out of frame: what was pulled can no longer be pulled, and the one strand still attached to the center clearly belongs to the viewer.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left, uppercase; accent words ['bisa','ngontrol'] on the emphasis phrase; subline clarifies the pivot.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Threads slide outward (slide) while the anchored line holds (controlledReveal), nodes fade past the safe margin; two systems max.
candidates.whyItWorks: Literal enactment of the metaphorHints' released rope, and it reframes surrender as clarity instead of loss.

candidates.metaphor: A ring turns left and right with real effort, but the shaft behind it is severed — the arrow ahead never moves, proving the input never reaches anyone.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Effort and transmission are decoupled: the ring's oscillating rotation is causally absent from the arrow's state, so the viewer watches an input with zero effect.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: We all know steering means the wheels turn; when the ring spins and the arrow stays dead still, the disconnection reads instantly without any text.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline above centered object, max 2 accent words ['pernah','ngontrol']; single label under the severed shaft.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Ring positionShift rotation, arrow held static (no motion = meaning), one glow subordinate to type.
candidates.whyItWorks: Uses a universally understood machine to make 'no control' a mechanical fact rather than an argument.

candidates.metaphor: A control panel toggle flips on and off with full confidence, but its wire is cut before it reaches the other side; the indicator on the far side stays permanently dim.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The switch performs the act of controlling while the severed wire proves the signal never arrives — the far indicator's unchanging dim state is the punchline.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A toggle that works yet lights nothing is instantly readable as a dead control; the gap in the wire explains why without narration.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left headline with accent on ['bisa','ngontrol']; right object labeled 'PIKIRAN ORANG LAIN'.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Toggle highlight flick between states (controlledReveal), indicator stays static, wire draws then stops (draw).
candidates.whyItWorks: Turns the metaphorHints' disconnected button into a scannable two-zone diagram, distinct from rope and wheel ideas.

candidates.metaphor: Big headline words reach toward floating judgment-nodes, touch them, and slide off every surface — no word ever fastens, while the type itself stays rock solid.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Repeated contact without attachment: accent words attempt connection (highlight) and fail (slide off), so the typography embodies an influence that cannot be seized.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Seeing a word bump against and slip off a floating circle reads as rejection/no-grip even with the sound off; the stable headline signals calm acceptance.
candidates.typographyStrategy: WordReveal is the scene's subject; accent words ['bisa','ngontrol']; max 4 lines, left aligned.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Word-by-word reveal (stagger), nodes positionShift away on contact, one subordinate glow behind the accent phrase.
candidates.whyItWorks: TypographyPriority is high on this beat, so making the type itself the actor maximizes impact with minimal elements.

candidates.concept: ONE ANCHOR IN A MOVING STREAM
candidates.metaphor: Judgment-bubbles stream across the frame in a fast current while a single vertical hairline anchored at center never bends — the current passes, the anchor doesn't move.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Two simultaneous trajectories: many elements in uncontrolled motion versus one element immune to them; the contrast of moving vs unmoving performs 'cannot control vs can hold'.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A rock in a river is a pre-verbal image; bubbles sliding past a fixed line reads as opinions passing you by while you stay put.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left column headline with accent ['pernah','ngontrol'], right side purely the stream; caption below the anchor.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Stream slides continuously (slide) at low density, anchor holds (controlledReveal), exit via fade; max two systems.
candidates.whyItWorks: Adds a motion-contrast solution distinct from grip, machine, and switch families, and it bridges to the next beat about influence.

candidates.metaphor: Opinions arrive as loud marks at full size; a gold dial rotates and the same marks pass through visibly smaller — input unchanged, amplitude controlled.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Two rows of identical opinion marks enter a dial zone; after the dial rotates, the marks re-emerge at reduced scale while staying present — the visual literally performs gain reduction rather than removal.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Big marks in, dial turns, same marks out but small: the viewer decodes 'it still exists, but I decide how loud it gets' without reading the line.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Uppercase headline left with gold accent on 'SEBESAR', small label naming the dial as 'VOLUME PENDAPAT'.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Dial rotation via positionShift, marks stagger in then scale down after emphasisAt — two motion systems max.
candidates.whyItWorks: Matches the metaphorHint 'katup pengatur volume' and enacts amplitude control as a physical, repeatable action.

candidates.concept: GLASS WALL THAT RETURNS THE BLOW
candidates.metaphor: Hostile arrows fly at the frame, strike a hairline glass plane, and bounce back untouched — opinions keep coming, none pass through.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Direction reversal at a visible barrier: incoming red arrows convert to outgoing dim arrows on contact, so the boundary is demonstrated by trajectory change, not by absence of attacks.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Arrows never reach the person behind the line; they hit and leave. The viewer reads 'their words stop here on my terms'.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline right-aligned, red accent only on the incoming-opinion phrase, teal reserved for the wall label.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Staggered arrow slide-ins, wall highlight on impact, bounced arrows fade out.
candidates.whyItWorks: Uses the glass-wall hint and turns emotional boundary into a mechanically legible event.

candidates.metaphor: A huge outer ring of 'their opinion' swallows the center; a small gold core pulls it inward until it becomes a tight collar the size of a coin.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Constant presence with decreasing radius: the ring never disappears, it only contracts toward the self — showing control over magnitude, not over existence.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: The circle stays but gets smaller around one bright dot: 'their judgment is still there, just no longer filling my life'.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Centered uppercase headline above, single gold accent word 'NGARUH', caption below naming the shrinking radius.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Outer circle subtleScale down to target size at emphasisAt, inner dot glow once.
candidates.whyItWorks: Directly uses the 'lingkaran pengaruh yang mengecil' hint and reads instantly even muted.

candidates.concept: ONE FADER PULLS THE MIX DOWN
candidates.metaphor: Four dim opinion channels run at full height; one gold fader slides down and only that channel collapses, leaving the others running.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Selective channel attenuation: siblings stay at full height while the controlled one drops, isolating the variable 'how much influence' from the constant 'they keep talking'.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A mixing-desk gesture everyone knows: I choose which input gets turned down, the noise source itself stays on.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-left, accent on 'KENDALI', channel labels tiny and muted beneath each fader.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Stagger bars in full, then controlledReveal drop on the gold bar with counterChange on its value label.
candidates.whyItWorks: A fresh fader metaphor distinct from knob/circles, and control is shown as a single deliberate hand action.

candidates.concept: GATE WAIVERS: MANY ENTER, LITTLE PASSES
candidates.metaphor: A crowd of opinion marks queues at a narrow gate; the gate aperture is set by the viewer, so the flow through to 'HIDUP LU' thins to a trickle.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Flow regulation: input volume constant upstream, throughput variable downstream — the aperture physically meters how much reaches the life area.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Same crowd outside, barely anything getting in: control shown as an opening size, not a wall.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline upper-left, emphasis on 'SEBESAR', caption labels upstream 'PENDAPAT MEREKA' vs downstream 'HIDUP LU'.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Stack of marks staggers toward gate, arrow slides through at reduced density after aperture shift.
candidates.whyItWorks: Turns 'seberapa besar' into a measurable aperture and separates opinion existence from its passage.

candidates.metaphor: Two outlined doorways side by side; theirs swings shut and dims while yours stays open and lit — they return to their space, you remain in yours.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The closing door physically removes one party from the shared frame while the open door keeps the other anchored, performing separation as an irreversible spatial event rather than a stated idea.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A door shutting on one side while the other stays open reads instantly as 'they left, you're still here' even with sound off.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Left headline split in two lines, emphasis phrase in gold on second line, small centered label under each door.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Doors slide apart (slide), one fades to dim (fade), headline word reveal with a single glow at the emphasis.
candidates.whyItWorks: Turns an emotional boundary into a mechanical event; the closing motion gives the 'kelegaan' beat a physical release.

candidates.metaphor: A single vertical hairline draws down the frame and everything left of it drifts away, everything right of it holds still — two living spaces cordonned apart.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The drawn line creates an impassable boundary; opposing drift on either side shows divergence as continuous motion, so the separation keeps happening on screen.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Opposing movement either side of a hard line is a universal diagram of 'different directions now' requiring no narration.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline stacked left of the line, emphasis phrase right of it — typography itself obeys the division.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Line draws top to bottom (draw), left text drifts and fades (slide/fade), right headline settles (reveal).
candidates.whyItWorks: Uses the type layout as the metaphor; high visual priority and high typography priority both satisfied in one frame.

candidates.metaphor: One incoming path splits at a node: a dim arrow bends away toward a fading home marker, a gold arrow continues straight ahead under the viewer.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Two trajectories physically diverge from a shared origin — one turns and exits the frame, the other persists forward — enacting 'pulang' versus 'tetap hidup' as competing motion vectors.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: A fork where one line turns off and the other runs on is read as a choice already made, before any text is processed.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Short uppercase headline top-left, emphasis phrase as a single gold-accented caption anchored to the continuing arrow.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Both arrows draw from the node (draw/stagger), departing one dims and slides out (fade), continuing one gets a subtle highlight.
candidates.whyItWorks: Direction of motion carries the meaning; the gold arrow gives one dominant accent with clear semantic role.

candidates.metaphor: Two soft orbs share one orbit, then the tether between them snaps and each drifts to its own closed circle — their life and your life become separate stable systems.
candidates.semanticMechanism: The broken tether converts a shared system into two independent self-contained loops; stability after the break shows separation as healthy, not loss.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Watching a link break and both bodies settle calmly into their own rings reads as a peaceful split rather than a conflict.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Centered headline above, emphasis phrase centered below with one gold word; max four elements kept.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Tether draws then dissolves (draw/dissolve), orbs settle outward (positionShift), single subordinate glow behind the gold phrase.
candidates.whyItWorks: Matches 'kelegaan' — the break resolves into balance, and one background glow stays under intensity 0.4.

candidates.metaphor: A dim framed rectangle of someone else's life slides off the edge of the screen while a solid outlined frame remains fixed and fills with light.
candidates.semanticMechanism: One frame physically exits while the other is held immovable — permanence is shown as what does not move when the other element is removed.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Motion vs stillness is the oldest visual cue for temporary vs permanent; the frame that never moves is obviously yours.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left, two micro-labels under the frames; emphasis phrase in gold as the only accented line.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Top frame slides out and fades (slide/fade), remaining frame highlights then glows gently (highlight, glow).
candidates.whyItWorks: Directly encodes 'sementara vs permanen' from the abstract meaning with minimal elements and clear hierarchy.

candidates.metaphor: A uniform grid of identical stamped tiles presses around one intact form that simply does not fit the press — and does not deform.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Conformity is shown as a mould; the grid's shared shape is the social template. The odd form is surrounded but never reshaped, so non-acceptance reads as fit, not failure.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Everyone else is the same shape pressed into the same slot; one different shape sits there whole. Difference is visibly structural, not a defect.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline uppercase left above grid; emphasis phrase in gold on 2 words; label under the odd form.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Grid cells stagger in dim, odd form enters with scale then holds — no deformation, subtleScale emphasis.
candidates.whyItWorks: Enacts the 'tak dipaksa muat cetakan' hint literally: the mould applies and the form declines it.

candidates.metaphor: One glowing node emits to surrounding nodes; most links stay dim and unconnected, yet the node keeps pulsing at full strength.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Social acceptance is rendered as connection coverage. Coverage is partial by design, while the source's luminance is independent of how many links return signal.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: The light keeps shining though most lines never light back — approval isn't what keeps it alive.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Centered headline over node cluster; accent teal on 'nggak semua'; caption as quiet resolution line.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Links draw outward then fade dim one by one; center pulses via glow, independent of link outcome.
candidates.whyItWorks: Turns audience reach into geometry: partial coverage becomes visible instead of felt as rejection.

candidates.metaphor: A balance scale tips toward a single intact form on one side against a crowd of identical small marks on the other — the lone form outweighs.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Quantity of approvers vs. wholeness of self are placed on opposing pans; the scale's tilt makes value physically override headcount.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: Many identical pieces are outweighed by one whole thing — the image argues worth isn't a headcount.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline left, two lines max; gold accent on 'diciptain'; badge labels the lone form.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Stack staggers in, beam slides to settle, lone circle positionShift into pan, then hold.
candidates.whyItWorks: A weighing act makes an abstract self-worth claim measurable and cold-viewer legible.

candidates.metaphor: Many parallel trajectories run in one direction while a single path angles away — and both continue past the shared horizon.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Belonging is shown as direction, not destination: divergence happens mid-frame yet no path terminates, so difference is coexistence rather than exile.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: One line goes a different way and keeps going as far as the others — nobody's route is cut off.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top-left across both halves; labels under each trajectory; emphasis gold on 'disukai semua'.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Parallel lines draw first, then the divergent path draws away; all hold at horizon, exits fade.
candidates.whyItWorks: Rejects the loss framing: leaving the pack is drawn as extension, not removal.

candidates.metaphor: A rounded form repeatedly approaches a matching slot and is shown at rest beside it, uninserted, still complete — the slot stays empty, unbothered.
candidates.semanticMechanism: Acceptance is a slot that stays unoccupied while the form remains whole; absence of fit is depicted as mutual non-event rather than expulsion.
candidates.whyViewerUnderstandsIt: It never clicks into place and nothing breaks — the piece just stays itself next to an empty gap.
candidates.typographyStrategy: Headline top, left-aligned; subline carries emphasis phrase with gold on 'semua orang'; label marks empty slot.
candidates.motionOpportunity: Slide toward slot, positionShift to rest, arrow draw shows approach then halt, fade out.
candidates.whyItWorks: Quietest option: performs 'nggak apa-apa' as stillness instead of triumph or conflict.
